notes: Flutter Dart-AOT release, Linux GTK embedder. frame_ms = interval between consecutive FrameTiming rasterFinish timestamps (engine raster thread finished the frame, frame handed to the GTK/GL presenter; NOT a guaranteed screen-update timestamp; no visibility into X11 present). Only frames the engine actually rasterized are reported (a frame with no dirty layer is never produced, so no empty frames are counted); continuous redraw by a Ticker that dirties the scene every tick. Frames filtered to rasterFinish within the measured window [start,end] after a 2 s warm-up; timings are batched by the engine so 800 ms extra were waited. Engine switches env: default-backend. text: Flutter has no virtualized single big text view; the file is split into lines (ListView.builder of Text) inside SelectableRegion. time_to_first_display_ms = main() entry -> rasterFinish of the first frame that built the text (excludes engine/VM startup before main). layout_ms = file read+split + buildDuration of that first frame (Flutter lays out lazily, only the viewport). Scroll = triangle wave 0..15000 px at 3000 px/s. Select-all at t=5 s via SelectableRegionState.selectAll(): with a lazy list only built lines are selected.
